title: Lien Record Reduction in the Rent Increase Limit of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The lien-record reduction on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement follows the agreement's lien steps in the **24 months** up to the handling date: no lien step at all takes **1 percentage point** off the limit percentage, lien steps such as an overlock without any lien notice take **half a point** (0.5 points) off, and a lien notice sent in that time takes nothing off. Points taken off never bring the limit percentage below zero (0 percent), so that a reduction never sets the rent below the rent before the increase.

The lien steps are the agreement's lien-step records — overlock applied or removed, preliminary letter, lien notice, sale advertisement, lock cut, lien hold placed or released — dated within the 24 months up to the handling date.

## Combinations

| Any lien step in the 24 months | A lien notice among them | Points off |
|---|---|---|
| no | — | 1 |
| yes | no | 0.5 |
| yes | yes | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- An overlock applied and removed 14 months before the handling date, no lien notice: half a point off.
- A lien notice sent 20 months before the handling date: nothing off.
- A lien notice sent 30 months before the handling date and nothing since: no lien step in the 24 months, 1 point off.
